where: Late evening in the old lanes of Kordavos: a narrow cobbled street of leaning timber houses under a low moon, mist between them, lanterns on brackets. The party stands at the near end. Some twenty paces ahead Silverhand walks away up the street with his representative and Varchk a step behind; Kaeleth lingers at the corner of the crossing further on, watching the way they came. A side alley turns off east before the crossing. Beyond the crossing the street runs under an archway in a house built across it.
